import { requirePrivateAccountMessage } from '@src/utils/privateAccountMessage';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 更换账号指令
 * 用法：/更换账号 <目标用户UID>
 * 发送验证码后，用户发送 /验证 <6位数字> 完成切换。
 */
import { initiateChangeAccount } from '@src/response-apps/emailSecurity/changeAccount/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  if (!(await requirePrivateAccountMessage(e))) {
    return;
  }
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const sendText = (text: string) => {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(text);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '更换账号', content: md }));
  };

  try {
    const initResult = await initiateChangeAccount({ bid, messageText: e.MessageText, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

    if (initResult.code === 'FAIL') {
      sendText(initResult.data.message);

      return;
    }

    const { currentUserEmail, targetUserName } = initResult.data;

    sendText(`切换目标：【${targetUserName}】\n验证码已发送至：【${currentUserEmail.split('').join(' ')}】\n请在3分钟内发送：/验证 6位验证码`);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('更换账号指令处理失败:', error);
    sendText('系统错误，请稍后再试或联系运营');
  }
});
